content: Choi, I was thinking about your mother's birthday. We should plan something special.
That's a great idea, Dad! What do you have in mind?
How about a trip to Shanghai? Just the three of us: you, me, and your mother.
Shanghai sounds amazing! When do you want to go?
Your mother's birthday is on December 17th. Let's leave on the 15th and stay for four days, three nights.
Perfect timing! I'll book the flights for us.
Great! And I'll take care of the gift.
What are you planning to get her?
A Louis Vuitton handbag. She's wanted one for a long time.
She'll love that, Dad! When will you give it to her?
During dinner on her birthday. We'll eat at a fancy restaurant called 'Diamond' at 6 PM.
That sounds perfect. I'll make sure everything runs smoothly.
Thanks, son. I can't wait to see your mother's face when she gets the gift.
It'll be a beautiful moment, Dad. Mom deserves the best.
